Usually. Tell us how many and roughly what ages when you phone and we will block the time together.

Around their first birthday, or whenever the first teeth appear.

Mid-morning and early afternoon are usually easiest to get.

fields.label: Main heading
fields.value: A dentist for Dennington, five minutes up the road.

fields.label: Introduction
fields.value: Dennington sits close enough to the Warrnambool CBD that getting to the dentist should never be the hard part of the day. For most households the drive is over before the radio has finished a song.

fields.label: Introduction
fields.value: That proximity changes how you can use a dental practice. School-hours appointments become practical, and so does bringing three children in on the same morning.

fields.label: Small heading
fields.value: What we offer

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Family check-ups & cleans — booked together on one morning where we can

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Children’s dentistry — first visits, fissure sealants and preventive advice

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Fillings — tooth-coloured composite

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Custom mouthguards — fitted before the football and netball season

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Night guards — for grinding and clenching

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Emergency appointments — knocks, breaks and toothache

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Crowns, bridges, root canal treatment, dentures and implants — available in the same practice when they are needed

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Some children qualify for a set amount of care under the Child Dental Benefits Schedule. Ask us and we will check. Lava Street Dental accepts eligible CDBS patients.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Ready to book? Give us a call on {{phone}}. We would love to look after your family.

fields.label: Small heading
fields.value: Getting to us

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Driving — head east along Raglan Parade into Warrnambool, then into the CBD grid to Lava Street, one block north of Koroit Street. Around five kilometres, usually under ten minutes outside the school run.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Parking — the Warrnambool Shopping Centre car park is simplest, with entries from Lava Street and Koroit Street. Ozone and Parkers are nearby, and Banyan Street generally has free on-street parking within the signed limits. Street parking near the practice is paid, and the shopping centre car park is free for two hours.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Bus — town routes connect Dennington with the Lava Street Interchange, on our street.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Cycling — the Port Fairy to Warrnambool Rail Trail runs through Dennington, and the CBD is an easy ride from most of the suburb.

fields.value: Common questions

fields.label: Paragraph

fields.label: Button words
fields.value: How early should I bring my child in?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Around their first birthday, or whenever the first teeth appear.

fields.label: Button words

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Mid-morning and early afternoon are usually easiest to get.

fields.value: What if a tooth gets knocked out at footy?

fields.label: Paragraph
